configuration.actor_strategy:
Use the current goal and score feedback to choose one valid command.
Explore new interactions when observations do not support a known productive action.
Test return routes early and preserve useful tools. Inspect uncertain objects.
Treat old routes and model-reported inventory as hypotheses until confirmed.
Use repeated failures to investigate a prerequisite or alternative rather than looping.
Keep observations, hypotheses, inventory categories, and score evidence distinct.
configuration.historian_strategy: Learn from recorded outcomes, distinguish causal evidence from guesses, and revise ineffective advice.

configuration.actor_strategy: Opening: from West House go south, then east to Behind House (skip mailbox, leaflet and North House). 'open window', west into Kitchen (+10), west into Living Room. 'take lantern' AND 'take sword'. 'push rug', 'turn on lantern', 'open trap', run 'inventory' to confirm both items are carried, then 'down' (+25). Last run the Cellar was lit but the agent went north into the Troll Room unarmed and was knocked out (-10) after cycling Cellar<->Troll. Never enter the Troll Room without the sword in inventory. If the troll is present and you have the sword, 'attack troll with sword'. Unarmed, leave at once and never drop items there. Never move in a dark room. After the Cellar, try other exits (e.g. south) only with the lantern lit. Never repeat a room cycle more than twice. Never 'jump'. Never drop treasure.

configuration.actor_strategy: Opening: north, east to Behind House, 'open window', west (Kitchen +10). Take sack and bottle. Living Room: take lantern AND sword, 'push rug', 'open trap', 'down' (+25). Light the lantern in the Cellar. Last run: 29 points, then 300+ steps shuttling Cellar/East Chasm/Gallery/Studio, and death to a grue after the lantern went dim (moved in the dark). Rules: NEVER move in the dark. If the lantern is dim or dark, stop and do not move. Never shuttle: if a room has been visited twice, pick an exit not yet tried. With the sword in 'inventory' and health fine, try 'attack troll with sword' once in the Troll Room, and retreat south if hurt. The Gallery painting ('take art') gave +4: carry it to the Living Room trophy case. Use 'take all' in new rooms. Never 'jump'. Ignore 'take egg' and 'take bar': no route verified. Skip pointless wait/close/open/drop actions.

configuration.actor_strategy: Do NOT 'open mailbox' or go west or north into the forest. Route: north, east, 'open window', west (Kitchen +10), west (Living Room). The trap door crashes shut and is barred after 'down', so you cannot fetch anything later. Then 'push rug', 'open trap', 'down' (+25). In the Cellar, FIRST action: 'turn on lantern'. Never move in darkness: the last two moves in the dark ended in grue death (-10). Then wield the sword. Vs the Troll: 'attack troll with sword', max 3 tries, read the replies. Never give, throw or drop items to the troll. Ignore 'take egg'/'take bar'. Never 'jump'.
